results.title: Germany – Wartung, Support und Weiterentwicklung der bestehenden Jitsi-Umgebung bei IT.NRW
results.why: Real software maintenance and development scope around an existing Jitsi environment. This is technically partnerable but specialist operations, references and service-level capability are not yet proven for SPM.

results.title: Germany – ISGA-Portal Weiterentwicklung und Support
results.why: Genuine portal development/support procurement, but bidder financial and reference evidence remains unresolved and the deadline is very close. Not safe to call GREEN without those gates.

results.title: Ireland – Contract Lifecycle Management solution for An Post
results.why: Real enterprise CLM implementation/support with integrations to ERP, procurement/finance, IAM, DMS, e-signature and CRM. Strong software fit but enterprise-product, security and implementation evidence make it a vendor/partner route rather than lean-direct.

results.title: TEGUC communications / outreach requirement
results.why: Communications/outreach scope is commercially brokerable, but execution includes local physical media, community relationships and distribution. A local field partner and US federal eligibility are essential.

results.title: Manufacturing Execution System software requirement
results.why: The DCE calls for a pre-existing MES compatible with specified additive-manufacturing equipment, including API/emulator/support capability. This is a software resale/integration opportunity only if a compliant commercial product partner is found.

results.title: Belgium – Facility Management Information System
results.why: Real enterprise FMIS implementation opportunity in Belgium. It fits a software-vendor/integrator strategy, but current evidence does not support a lean SPM-direct bid.

results.title: Belgium – GitLab Enterprise Premium Self-Managed licensing
results.why: Potentially simple licensing resale, but profitability and eligibility depend on an authorized channel and supplier pricing. Keep as reseller investigation, not a direct GREEN.

results.title: VMware / Broadcom licensing and support procurement
results.why: High-value licensing/support opportunity, but it is channel-dependent. SPM should treat it as a resale play only after an authorized partner and viable margin are secured.

results.title: Poland – software support / maintenance requirement
results.why: Potential reseller/support lane, but authorization and local service requirements remain decisive. No direct SPM capability should be inferred.

results.title: Belgium – Oracle licensing/support procurement for SPW
results.why: Large licensing opportunity but entirely dependent on Oracle channel eligibility and economics. Keep as a commercial partner play rather than a software-delivery GREEN.

results.title: Ireland – Veterinary Clinical Skills, Simulation and Immersive Learning Platform
results.why: TED lane of the same ATU immersive-learning procurement already identified through the national eTenders lane. High-value and relevant but PQQ/reference/insurance heavy, so partner-only on present evidence.

results.title: Physical Security Services, Coos Bay District BLM
results.why: False semantic fit. This is a physical security-services procurement, not a software-development opportunity suitable for lean SPM execution.

results.title: France – Co-commissariat aux comptes France Travail
blockers: Professional qualification requirement outside SPM model
results.why: This is a regulated statutory audit mandate, not a generic IT/services opportunity. The semantic IT-services hit is not commercially relevant for SPM.

results.title: Malta – medical X-ray equipment procurement
results.why: Physical regulated medical-equipment supply with specialist compliance requirements. Not a realistic SPM lean/broker target from current evidence.

screening_note: These are second-tier materially resolvable survivors from the same 160-candidate sweep. Remaining rows stay non-final where decisive DCE evidence or a supplier/channel feasibility check is still absent; they must not be forced to PASS or RED solely to empty the queue.
